[ASSISTANT_SAID] Caltech has several policies and resources in place to support mental health and wellness among its students and staff.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Counseling and Psychological Services: Caltech has a dedicated counseling service that provides individual and group therapy to students, staff, and faculty.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The service also offers crisis intervention, psychiatric services, and referrals to other resources as needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mental Health Leave of Absence: Students may take a mental health leave of absence for up to one year.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Disability Services: Students with mental health conditions may be eligible for accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mental Health Awareness: Caltech's Student Affairs office provides mental health awareness training to staff and faculty.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Support Groups: Caltech offers support groups for students with specific mental health concerns, such as anxiety, depression, and eating disorders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Employee Assistance Program: Caltech's EAP provides confidential counseling and support services to staff and faculty.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wellness Program: Caltech's Wellness Program promotes healthy lifestyle choices and offers resources such as nutrition counseling, fitness classes, and mindfulness workshops.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Caltech is committed to maintaining a healthy and supportive environment for its students and staff.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Peer Health Advocates (PHA): The PHA program consists of trained student volunteers who promote health and wellness on campus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Graduate Student Council (GSC) Mentoring Program: The GSC Mentoring Program matches new graduate students with experienced students for support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Undergraduate and Graduate Mentorship Programs: Caltech offers several mentorship programs connecting students with mentors from different areas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Student Clubs and Organizations: There are numerous student clubs and organizations at Caltech focusing on mental health and wellness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Caltech offers workshops throughout the year that teach students various techniques and strategies for managing stress.
